cues.text: The dorm lounge. Aigis is back, sitting with everyone on the sofas around the table.
Aigis springs up from her seat.
Aigis sits back down with a small smile.
Aigis closes her eyes. Her Persona, Palladion, floats in empty space, a helmeted figure in flowing robes with shards of light drifting around it.
Palladion is gone. In its place stands Athena, a helmeted woman holding a long lance and a huge round shield, rays bursting out behind her.
The lounge again, everyone seated around Aigis as before.
